name: COCO-SOC
description: Reference implementation, benchmark construction, mechanistic probes (P1-P6) and the complete raw run logs behind every table and figure in the article "Mechanistic Evaluation of Transformer-based Architectures for Enhanced Small Object Detection in Crowded Computer Vision Scenes: Density-Steered Token Attention" (Computer Vision and Image Understanding). Includes: the DSTA encoder and every baseline variant; the CrowdSynth-D generator; the COCO-SOC selection criterion, image identifiers and construction script; 35 per-run JSON records with metrics, probe measurements and full loss histories; and the analysis code that regenerates every table and figure from those logs. Code is released under MIT; run logs, figures and generated tables under CC BY 4.0. MS-COCO images are not redistributed.
